messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or a holiday that is observed on the nearest weekday when it lands on a weekend, giving you at least three consecutive days off.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day | Jan 1 2023 was a Sunday → observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Mar 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Mar 20 2023 was a Monday. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (most provinces) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in many provinces; the weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | May 22 2023 was a Monday. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day | Jul 1 2023 was a Saturday → observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Sep 4 2023 was a Monday. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Oct 9 2023 was a Monday. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day | Nov 11 2023 was a Saturday → observed on Monday Nov 13. |
| **Dec 23–26** | Christmas & Boxing Day | Dec 25 2023 was a Monday; Dec 26 2023 a Tuesday – together they give a 4‑day weekend. |

### Quick‑look by month

| Month | Long Weekend(s) |
|-------|-----------------|
| January | Jan 1–2 (New Year’s Day) |
| March | Mar 18–20 (Family Day – Ontario & others) |
| April | Apr 7–9 (Good Friday) |
| May | May 20–22 (Victoria Day) |
| July | Jul 1–3 (Canada Day) |
| September | Sep 2–4 (Labour Day) |
| October | Oct 7–9 (Thanksgiving) |
| November | Nov 11–13 (Remembrance Day) |
| December | Dec 23–26 (Christmas & Boxing Day) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, etc.), you’ll have to add those separately. The table above covers the federal holidays that create long weekends across the country in 2023.

So long weekend September 2-4. Thanksgiving October 9 (Monday). So long weekend Oct 7-9. Remembrance Day Nov 11 (Saturday). Observed on Monday Nov 13. So long weekend Nov 11-13.
